layout.arrow_legend_placement: Below the full diagram, above the limitations note
layout.production_requirement: Complete titles, blocks, connections, arrowheads and legends must be authored and exported together in Canva.

nodes.title: Sample access
nodes.body:
Verify reachable water or
vessel, stable dry support,
and probe clearance.

nodes.title: Sampling interlock
nodes.body:
Drive inhibited; calibration
ready. Check support and
clearance before
immersion.

nodes.title: Prepare sample
nodes.body:
Rinse probes; avoid
bubbles; set immersion.
Record sample identity
and temperature.

nodes.title: Record and stow
nodes.body:
Retain raw values, units
and validity. Clean and
stow probes before
motion resumes.

nodes.title: Calibration and checks
nodes.body:
Use buffer or standard
calibration. Check settling,
drift, cleanliness and
range.

nodes.title: Probe acquisition
nodes.body:
High-impedance pH
interface and clean
turbidity optics yield
timestamped raw data.

diagrams.limitations: Proposed workflow. Module-specific calibration, controlled immersion and full-travel cable clearance require physical verification.
diagrams.caption_semantics: Water assessment couples sample preparation and probe acquisition with calibration readiness, quality checks, traceable records and safe stowing.
routing_notes: Place the six nodes in the specified two-row layout.
Route quality-to-interlock vertically through the centre gutter.
Route stow confirmation along the left outer gutter; do not imply that a recorded value automatically permits driving.
diagrams.status_footer: Proposed workflow; calibration, immersion and cable clearance require physical verification.

nodes.title: Handling request
nodes.body:
Authorized operator or
mission specifies object,
approach, grasp and
release location.

nodes.title: Reach and stability
nodes.body:
Check payload, support
margin, joint limits,
collision clearance and
cable bend limits.

nodes.title: Arm controller
nodes.body:
Generate bounded,
low-speed joint and
gripper commands; halt
on detected faults.

nodes.title: Handling outcome
nodes.body:
Verify placement; retain
failed grasps, protective
stops and recovery
actions.

nodes.title: Feedback [proposed]
nodes.body:
Position, current and grip
feedback: tracking error,
jams and unexpected
contact.

nodes.title: Joints and gripper
nodes.body:
Geared actuators use the
preserved arm mounting,
secured sleeves and
service loops.

diagrams.limitations: Proposed feedback architecture. Joint models, payload capacity and reliable grasp confirmation require measurement.
diagrams.caption_semantics: Reach and stability checks gate arm commands; proposed feedback closes the control loop and supports verified handling outcomes.
routing_notes: Use top-row forward commands and bottom-row returned evidence.
Route feedback-to-controller through the centre-right gutter, without crossing the actuator command arrow.
Route outcome-to-request vertically along the left gutter.
diagrams.status_footer: Proposed feedback; joint models, payload capacity and grasp confirmation require measurement.

nodes.title: Sensing [proposed]
nodes.body:
Range or depth sensing,
IMU and encoders; GNSS
only where available.

nodes.title: Localization
nodes.body:
Calibrate and synchronize
observations. Estimate
pose, covariance and
validity.

nodes.title: Map and obstacles
nodes.body:
Combine pose with range
observations. Update
occupancy, clearance and
dynamic obstacles.

nodes.title: Recovery and supervision
nodes.body:
Check pose and link
health. Request replan,
takeover or controlled
stop.

nodes.title: Drive execution
nodes.body:
Bound motion and
allocate wheel targets.
Monitor timeouts and
actuator state.

nodes.title: Feasible planning
nodes.body:
Plan routes and local
motion within steering,
footprint, speed and
stopping limits.

diagrams.limitations: Development architecture. Sensor compatibility, localization robustness and closed-loop navigation remain to be demonstrated on the rover.
diagrams.caption_semantics: Sensing feeds both localization and mapping; planning proposes feasible motion while supervision can stop or replan execution.
routing_notes: Route direct sensor-to-map observations above the localization block.
Use distinct parallel lanes between supervision and execution for control and feedback.
Route supervisor-to-planner commands below the bottom row; never draw a serial execution-to-recovery-only chain.
diagrams.status_footer: Proposed autonomy; compatible sensors, calibration and rover navigation trials are required.

nodes.title: Operator dashboard
nodes.body:
Show requested and
active modes, stale-data
warnings and a proposed
authenticated session.

nodes.title: ESP access point
nodes.body:
Local Wi-Fi exchanges
commands and telemetry
without external Internet
infrastructure.

nodes.title: Protocol and arbiter
nodes.body:
Validate sequence, age,
limits and mode. Accept
one command authority at
a time.

nodes.title: Telemetry and video
nodes.body:
State and sensor packets
plus camera video; use
separate bandwidth
budgets.

nodes.title: Mega controller
nodes.body:
Bound commands; read
sensors. Report watchdog
and actuator state.

nodes.title: Radio operator input
nodes.body:
Alternate radio requests;
deliberate handover and
neutral commands
required.

diagrams.limitations: Proposed integration. Authentication, timeout policy, handover and communication range require implementation and testing.
diagrams.caption_semantics: Wi-Fi and radio are parallel command sources entering one arbiter; telemetry returns to the dashboard through a separately budgeted path.
routing_notes: Keep radio-to-arbiter independent of the telemetry path.
Use separate parallel lanes for operator requests and display data.
Route arbiter-controller control and controller-arbiter feedback as two directed paths through the right-centre gutter.
Camera input is included within the telemetry block; do not imply that Mega generates or processes the video stream.
diagrams.status_footer: Proposed integration; authentication, handover, timeouts and communication range require tests.

nodes.title: Disarmed
nodes.body:
Actuator outputs inhibited.
Health checks and
deliberate enable precede
motion.

nodes.title: Ready / manual
nodes.body:
One operator holds
command authority.
Neutral inputs and valid
health are required.

nodes.title: Autonomous [proposed]
nodes.body:
Valid mission and pose
permit motion. Monitor
obstacles and health.

nodes.title: Emergency stop
nodes.body:
Latched motor-energy
interruption. Independent
circuit; release and reset
required.

nodes.title: Controlled safe stop
nodes.body:
Stop drive; hold or park
the arm. Restart requires
fault clearance and
deliberate reset.

nodes.title: Degraded
nodes.body:
Recoverable sensor or
link fault. Reduced
operation requires
explicitly authorized limits.

diagrams.limitations: Selected proposed transitions, not verified safety logic. Emergency interruption is independent of software; arm holding and reset hardware require verification.
diagrams.caption_semantics: Normal, degraded and stopped states have explicit entry conditions; emergency input reaches the latched emergency state from every active state.
routing_notes: Do not chain emergency stop only after controlled stop: direct emergency transitions apply from all four active states.
Route emergency-input branches through a shared outer perimeter corridor, with a single repeated-condition label and visible source branches.
Use separate arrowheads into the emergency block; merge only branches with the identical emergency-input condition.
Keep reset routes separate from the emergency-input corridor.
These are state-transition arrows, not electrical-power or physical-wire arrows; therefore the legend uses control only.
The diagram intentionally omits secondary transitions; never infer automatic restart from fault clearance alone.
diagrams.status_footer: Selected proposed transitions. Emergency interruption is independent; no automatic restart.

nodes.title: Define mission
nodes.body:
Air patrol, inspection,
water sampling,
lightweight handling or
reconnaissance.

nodes.title: Pre-mission checks
nodes.body:
Check power, links and
sensor readiness. Log
calibration IDs and
operator authority.

nodes.title: Approach and observe
nodes.body:
Use controlled travel and
camera observation.
Retain pose, timestamps
and health status.

nodes.title: Mission record
nodes.body:
Link data to pose and
time. Retain raw/derived
values, failures and
interventions.

nodes.title: Quality and recovery
nodes.body:
Check validity and task
completion. Flag
uncertainty; hold, retry or
abort if needed.

nodes.title: Execute task
nodes.body:
Dwell for air observation,
immerse probes, handle
lightweight samples or
inspect visually.

diagrams.limitations: Proposed task workflow. Completion requires valid observations or confirmed handling; reaching a waypoint alone is insufficient.
diagrams.caption_semantics: Readiness gates travel and task execution; quality checks receive both task evidence and navigation context and can request recovery.
routing_notes: Use distinct opposing lanes between task and quality: observations leftward, retry requests rightward.
Route approach-to-quality context through the row gutter and quality-to-approach recovery through an outer right corridor.
Keep record output independent of the recovery loop; failed or aborted attempts remain reportable.
diagrams.status_footer: Proposed workflow. Completion needs valid observations or verified handling, not arrival alone.

nodes.title: External UCI data
nodes.body:
Eight predictors and CO
target. Exclude missing
targets and complete
predictor outages.

nodes.title: Chronological partition
nodes.body:
Sort eligible rows: 5,140
training, 1,102 validation
and 1,102 test
observations.

nodes.title: Training only
nodes.body:
Fit preprocessing and
models on training only.
No validation or test
refitting.

nodes.title: Future rover validation
nodes.body:
Require reference
co-location, later
deployments and onboard
resource measurements.

nodes.title: Frozen test evaluation
nodes.body:
Score 1,102 later hours
with frozen models.
Report errors and paired
day intervals.

nodes.title: Validation selection
nodes.body:
Rank 21 candidates by
validation RMSE. Lock
selections before testing.

diagrams.limitations: External fixed-station benchmark. No test-to-training feedback; transferring the method does not calibrate or validate the rover's MQ sensors.
diagrams.caption_semantics: Training, validation and test inputs remain separate; selection is locked before frozen-pipeline evaluation, followed by independent rover-specific validation.
routing_notes: Draw separate outgoing branches from partition to training, validation and test.
Route validation-only rows around the right outside edge so they never pass through training.
Use one data arrow from training to test for retained fitted pipelines and one control arrow from validation to test for the selection lock.
Never draw a return arrow from the held-out test to model fitting or hyperparameter selection.
The last node is a future validation requirement, not permission to deploy the external model.
diagrams.status_footer: External fixed-station benchmark; independent rover calibration and validation remain required.
